heroHeadline: China Coast Guard Water-Cannons Philippine Ship, Delays Navy Sailor's Medevac at Ayungin Shoal
heroSubtitle: A medical evacuation from BRP Sierra Madre was delayed about ten hours on Oct 8 after Chinese vessels used a water cannon and rejected the proposed rendezvous point.
